vulnerabilities.title: File Parsing Vulnerability in Simcenter Femap Before V2512
vulnerabilities.summary: Siemens Simcenter Femap versions before V2512 are affected by uninitialized memory vulnerability that could be triggered when the application reads files in SLDPRT format. If a user is tricked to open a malicious file with the affected application, an attacker could leverage the vulnerability to perform remote code execution in the context of the current process.

affected_products.remediation: Update to V2512 or later version

mitigations: Product-specific remediations or mitigations can be found in the section Known Affected Products.
Please follow the General Security Recommendations.
general_recommendations: As a general security measure, Siemens strongly recommends to protect network access to devices with appropriate mechanisms.
In order to operate the devices in a protected IT environment, Siemens recommends to configure the environment according to Siemens' operational guidelines for Industrial Security.

vulnerabilities.title: Denial of Service Vulnerability in Interniche IP-Stack based Industrial Devices
vulnerabilities.summary: Multiple industrial devices using the Interniche IP-Stack are affected by a denial of service vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted network packets to cause a denial of service condition.
mitigations: Restrict network access to affected devices.

vulnerabilities.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in RUGGEDCOM ROX Before V2.17
vulnerabilities.summary: RUGGEDCOM ROX devices are affected by multiple vulnerabilities that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands or escalate privileges.
general_recommendations: Siemens recommends to update the affected products to the latest version.

vulnerabilities.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in SINEC Security Monitor before V4.10.0
vulnerabilities.summary: SINEC Security Monitor is affected by multiple vulnerabilities that could allow an authenticated attacker to access sensitive data or cause a denial of service.
mitigations: Restrict access to the web interface to trusted users only.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Server Certificate Validation in IAM Client
vulnerabilities.summary: The IAM Client does not properly validate server certificates, which could allow a man-in-the-middle attacker to intercept communications.

vulnerabilities.title: Deserialization Vulnerability in Siemens Engineering Platforms before V20
vulnerabilities.summary: Siemens Engineering Platforms are affected by a deserialization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code when a specially crafted project file is opened.
mitigations: Do not open untrusted project files.
Apply software updates from official Siemens sources only.

vulnerabilities.title: Denial of Service Vulnerability in Ruggedcom ROS devices before V5.10.1
vulnerabilities.summary: Ruggedcom ROS devices are affected by a denial of service vulnerability in the web server component.
mitigations: Restrict access to the web interface.

vulnerabilities.title: Authentication Bypass Vulnerability in Energy Services Using Elspec G5DFR
vulnerabilities.summary: Energy services using the Elspec G5DFR are affected by an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow unauthorized access.
mitigations: Restrict physical access to the device.

vulnerabilities.title: RADIUS Protocol Susceptible to Forgery Attacks (CVE-2024-3596) - Impact to SCALANCE, RUGGEDCOM and Related Products
vulnerabilities.summary: Multiple Siemens products using RADIUS protocol are affected by a forgery attack vulnerability that could allow an attacker to bypass authentication.

affected_products.remediation: Apply workaround or update when available
Apply workaround or update when available
Apply workaround or update when available

mitigations: Configure RADIUS to require Message-Authenticator on all requests and responses.
general_recommendations: Enable secure RADIUS communication wherever possible.

vulnerabilities.title: Buffer Overflow in SIMATIC HMI Panels
vulnerabilities.summary: SIMATIC HMI Panels are affected by critical buffer overflow vulnerabilities that could allow remote code execution without authentication.

affected_products.remediation: Update to V17 Update 5 or later
Update to V17 Update 5 or later

mitigations: Isolate affected devices from the network until patches can be applied.
Monitor network traffic for suspicious activity.
general_recommendations: Keep all firmware and software up to date.
